column1: # Upstream support status of Kryptik's pinned release series, read by tools/check-support-status.sh.
# Each row says where and when it was read: an unsourced, undated support date rots unseen.
# Whitespace-separated; the note runs to the end of the line.
#   package       source name, as in sources.lock and tools/fetch-sources.sh
#   config_var    the pin in build/config/versions.env
#   series        the release series this row describes, or * for any series
#   status        supported | security-only | none-published | delegated
#   support_ends  YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM when upstream gives only a month, or - for a tier
#   policy_url    the upstream page this row was read from
#   retrieved     the date it was read
#   note          free text
#   supported       until support_ends; a tier with no date (perl's) never expires, so the note names it
#   security-only   security fixes only: a warning, the last stop before end of life
#   none-published  upstream publishes no support window; NOT a claim that the pin is current
#   delegated       established by the tool the note names, which --strict requires to exist
# A pinned series with no row fails --strict.
# Take each row from upstream's own page, never a distribution's tracker or an end-of-life aggregator.
# package  config_var   series  status          support_ends  policy_url                                            retrieved   note
